C1226.title: Shenzhen Proposes Heavy Fines for Big Data-Enabled Price Discrimination
keywords: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Data Regulation
Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee
C1226.summary: In June 2021, the draft Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Data Regulation was released for public comment, explicitly granting natural persons the right to refuse user profiling and personalized recommendations at any time. It introduces severe penalties for big data-enabled price discrimination, starting at 50,000 yuan, with serious cases facing fines up to 50 million yuan or 5% of the previous year

references.title: Public Opinion Supports: Big Data Discrimination Fines Up to 50 Million Yuan
